interface.longDescription: Untested on Codex. Fourteen skills that take a team from raw AI-product traces to a trusted, CI-gated eval suite: error discovery, binary judges, calibration, tasks, trials and suites, over an evals/ directory in git. The skills call the litmustest CLI, installed separately.
